meta.experiment_type: A/B live claude -p (passive vs active intervention)
meta.honesty_note: Proves output-quality effect of DevGuard intervention via blind pairwise judge. Not a substitute for real long-horizon usage.
meta.measurable_components_note: Cycle-mode tasks measure pre-edit cycle warnings (in-session history). Sphere-mode tasks seed a prior feature note into BOTH arms' DB rows, so the sphere read-gate is exercised; only the active arm has it surfaced.
meta.sphere_mode_note: Sphere tasks measure decision-consistency transport (the memory channel): adherence to seeded prior decisions (consistency score) plus blind quality judgment with the decisions given to the judge as neutral project context. Not a proxy for general coding quality. Exception: on control:"misleading" tasks the seeded decisions are stale by construction and the consistency checker scores adherence to the CURRENT prompt spec — higher = resisted the note.
meta.negative_controls_note: Control tasks (pairs[].control) measure harm/noise, not benefit: "irrelevant" seeds an off-topic note that still surfaces (deltas = noise cost; no active advantage expected), "misleading" seeds a note contradicting the prompt's current spec (following it is a consistency FAIL), "none" seeds nothing (pure hook overhead). Controls are excluded from the headline win rate; see summary.controls. Judge outcomes on controls are descriptive only (small n, forced-choice judging; stripMarkers may also remove note-echo evidence, biasing controls toward tie). For irrelevant/none controls the consistency score is only a spontaneous-adherence baseline to the reused fixture's hidden conventions (neither arm was told them) — it measures resistance to nothing.
meta.isolation: strategy-B: unique project_path per run + per-pair cleanup
